author: Astrokillah
text:
Hi Salivan, I love what you're doing here! Let me share my thought on your Gold trade. Start with Daily chart:

So, around 8 September 2017, price broke into the compression zone, it
cleared two peaks inside the compression but could not break above the
3rd.

Now going into 1-min chart to see where these levels were broken:

The important engulf should be the one that broke FL-A. Next we zoom
into the area above FL-A to see how smaller-scaled FLs interact with
each other.

Here's where a bit of subjectivity comes in: Would you drew B or C as
the FL that held price up? Salivan used B, but remember, neither B or C
broke anything significant to the left, so I drew both as I can see
price reacting to both. So what happened to price next?

Well, FL-C was engulfed and this created FL-D. Price tried to break
below B but the first attempt was not successful, it bounced back up
towards the MPL of FL-D where it reloaded and then came down to engulf B
 successfully. It tried to engulf FL-A and again the first attempt was
not successful, it bounced up to FL-D again, reloaded, and then came
down and finally engulfed A. This tells us that FL-D is very strong
since it is the source of the engulf of FL-A. In the meantime, FL-E was
created after engulfing B and also the CPAZ inside A.

Next I tried to investigate why after engulfing B, price retraced to
point [1], was it because of a iQM level in area [3] as pointed out by
Salivan?

I looked at 10s chart below:

So now, imagine we were still on the 8 September, and the chart below is
 what we were seeing, with all the analysis above, I asked myself the
question: Where would I have planned the trade?

So while I think it is logical to place SL just above FL-E, I still need
 to establish a good entry level, and for this, I need to look into 10s
chart again to see if there is a clean DP at the MPL of E? What I saw
was a small scale QM, so a good level to short would be 1355.343?

I apologize if I have uploaded too many charts.

AK
